summary: ansible-vault decrypt permanently saves files unencrypted to disk.
questions: How do I permanently remove vault encryption from a file?
What is the difference between ansible-vault decrypt and edit?

answer_card.title: Permanently decrypt files
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-vault decrypt foo.yml bar.yml baz.yml
```

This writes the files back to disk **unencrypted**. If you only want to change content, use `ansible-vault edit` instead.
